title: Apple One Price in 2026: Every Plan and What You Save
summary: Apple One price in 2026 depends on which plan you choose. Calculate whether bundling saves money compared to paying for each service individually.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Apply the same rule to every answer below. Each comes from Apple's own pages, and each is worth confirming on your own screen before you act on it, because Apple changes offers without notice.


Is there a free trial for Apple One?


Apple offers a trial to some new subscribers, but eligibility depends on your account history. If you've already used trials of services the bundle contains, you may be offered a shorter one or none.


The checkout screen is the only reliable record of what your Apple Account qualifies for.


### Can I switch between Apple One plans without losing my storage?


Yes, but the direction matters. Apple's support pages say you change plans under Subscriptions in your account settings. Moving up adds storage.


Moving down to a plan with less iCloud+ storage than you currently use doesn't delete your files, but it **can stop new backups and uploads** until you free space or buy storage separately.


Before downgrading, compare your used storage with the smaller plan's allowance. Check when the change takes effect, because Apple's pages distinguish between changes that apply immediately and changes that wait for the next billing date.


Is there a student discount on Apple One?


Not on the bundle itself, as far as Apple's Apple One page shows: it lists the Individual, Family and Premier plans and no student tier.


Apple Music has its own student plan, sold separately, and that's the route to check if music is the main service you'd use.


Can I add or remove one service from Apple One?


No. Each plan is a fixed set of services. If you only want some of them, Apple's answer is to cancel the bundle and subscribe to those services individually.


This is why the three-service test matters: you can't drop the service you never use and keep the discount.


### Does Apple One work on Android or Windows?


Partly. Some services, such as Apple Music, have Android apps and web access, and iCloud has a Windows version. Others, including Apple Fitness+ and Apple Arcade, are built around Apple devices.


Treat the bundle's value as the services you can actually open on the devices you own. A service you can't use on your phone or laptop counts as zero in your own comparison, whatever it contributes to the bundle's price.
